sentences.text: Color of Night is a 1994 American erotic mystery thriller film produced by Cinergi Pictures and released in the United States by Hollywood Pictures .	Hollywood Pictures	Hollywood Pictures	Cinergi Pictures	Cinergi Pictures	erotic mystery thriller	Erotic thriller
Directed by Richard Rush , the film stars Bruce Willis and Jane March .	Richard Rush	Richard Rush (director)	Bruce Willis	Bruce Willis	Jane March	Jane March

The cast also features Ruben Blades , Lesley Ann Warren , Brad Dourif , Lance Henriksen , Kevin J. O'Connor and Scott Bakula .	Ruben Blades	Ruben Blades	Lesley Ann Warren	Lesley Ann Warren	Brad Dourif	Brad Dourif	Lance Henriksen	Lance Henriksen	Kevin J. O'Connor	Kevin J. O'Connor (actor)	Scott Bakula	Scott Bakula
It is one of two well-known works by director Rush , the other being The Stunt Man 14 years before .	The Stunt Man	The Stunt Man
Color of Night flopped at the box office and won a Golden Raspberry Award as the worst film of 1994 .	Golden Raspberry Award	Golden Raspberry Award
Nonetheless , it became one of the 20 most-rented films in the United States home video market in 1995 .
Maxim magazine also singled the film out as having the Best Sex Scene in film history .

causal_questions.question: Color of Night is still in production.
